content.comment_body: I'm trying to use [product_name] to retrieve counts every 60 seconds, but sometimes it doesn't log exactly every 60 seconds—it varies (e.g., 64 or 65 seconds). Why does it fail to log at precise intervals as expected? Example attached. Thanks for any assistance.
Consider starting a support request for further assistance.

It’s possible your computer is busy running other processes, causing Excel to miss the scheduled task timing. Check your Task Manager to see if CPU or memory usage is high. You could also create a VBA macro to log time every 65 seconds and see if it maintains a regular schedule. Here’s a helpful link: [url]

To help diagnose the problem, please upload a Wireshark capture file of your application. Also, provide the IP addresses of your [product_name] and your computer. If possible, disconnect other Ethernet devices during the test. Wireshark can be downloaded here: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces inconsistent intervals when using [product_name] to pull counts every 60 seconds, with logs sometimes happening at 64-65 seconds intervals. Other users suggest this could be due to system resource limitations, Excel constraints, or network activity affecting the regularity.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to log counts exactly every 60 seconds with no deviations.
